sections.heading: Committed
paragraphs: Release the gateway health panel pilot. Finish regional export cursor validation. Document new webhook diagnostics in Fleet Console help.

sections.heading: Deferred
paragraphs: Delay multi-region tenant transfer until the residency exception flow has independent verification. Keep custom alert calendars in discovery until two customer pilots confirm need.

sections.heading: Review
paragraphs: Owners review progress each Thursday. Changes in committed scope require an updated customer communication plan and a note in the release tracker.
